q: Why is the B006 fix (cache={} to cache=None) unsafe?
o: Code may rely on the shared default object
why: Unsafe fixes may change what the code does at run time.

q: Which command shows what --fix would change without writing anything?
why: --diff prints a unified diff and changes no files.

q: In CI, which command fails when a file isn't formatted?
why: --check writes nothing and exits 1 if a file would change.

q: ruff format also sorts your imports.
why: Myth: sorting is lint rule I001; run ruff check --select I --fix, then ruff format.

q: ruff format changes layout but never what the code does.
why: Fact: that is the difference between a formatter and a lint fix.
